# Pinnacle Verification Centre

> Source-led evidence for Pinnacle Blooms Network and Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited.

Source review: 15 September 2026. Selected originals and review conclusions rechecked: 24 September 2026. This site summarizes documentary evidence and is not a regulator’s certification service. Preserve the review status and scope limits when citing a record. A protocol is not completed validation; a management-system certificate does not guarantee a child’s outcome. Source review does not establish endorsement by the issuing organisations.

Evidence owner: Sourabh Sashank · Lead PinnacleAI® · care@pinnacleblooms.org · 9100 181 181.

## MD-5 · Class B manufacturing licence

Canonical: https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html
Category: Medical device regulation
Review status: Original reviewed
Current issuer or registry status: not independently confirmed.

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 · Non-diagnostic developmental-support software

Licence number: MFG/MD/2026/000248
Issuer: State Licensing Authority · Telangana Drugs Control Administration
Licence holder: Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Pvt. Ltd.
Issued: 21 April 2026
Intended population: Children aged 0–12
Intended functions: Developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support
Export certificate: Free Sale Certificate FSC/MD/2026/000741 · 23 September 2026

Family relevance: A defined intended use lets your family understand what the software is designed to support and when professional clinical evaluation is needed.

What this supports: The supplied Form MD-5 licenses the listed Class B device for manufacture for sale or distribution at the specified premises. Intended users include parents, therapists, educators and caregivers supporting children aged 0–12.

Scope and limits: Applies to the named device, version, intended use and premises. It does not establish diagnostic authority, clinical effectiveness or the registration of every centre.

Source note: The operative licence reads 000248. A corrected forwarding letter also reads 000248; the older forwarding letter supplied as PinnacleAI®_SAMD_License_CL.pdf also reads 000150. The CL file is a forwarding letter, not a separate classification approval. Use the operative licence and corrected letter together. Free Sale Certificate FSC/MD/2026/000741 was issued on this licence on 23 September 2026; see the FSC record.

Source citation: Original Form MD-5, page 1 including device annexure; supplied PinnacleAI®_SAMD_License.pdf re-inspected 18 September 2026.
Reviewed: 15 September 2026
- [Free Sale Certificate record](https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/fsc.html)

## FSC · Free Sale Certificate for export

Canonical: https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/fsc.html
Category: Medical device regulation
Review status: Original reviewed
Evidence scope: Export-purpose certificate
Source review conclusion: Certificate FSC/MD/2026/000741 was inspected and its device particulars agree with the operative MD-5 scope. It establishes Indian domestic marketability and export eligibility subject to the importing country’s law. No foreign registration or comparative superiority is claimed.
Original certificate and forwarding letter inspected. Their populated signature fields were observed, but cryptographic signature validity was not independently verified.

Export-purpose certificate issued on the MD-5 licence · PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0

Certificate number: FSC/MD/2026/000741
Issuer: State Licensing Authority · TG SAFE (Telangana Standards Authority for Food and Essential Drugs), Government of Telangana
Licence holder: Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited
Issued: 23 September 2026
Base licence: Form MD-5 · MFG/MD/2026/000248
Permitted activity: Manufacture and sale in the domestic market as per Indian law; export as per the law of the importing country
Device as printed: Developmental Support Software (Non-Diagnostic) · Software as a Medical Device · Class B · PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 · children aged 0–12 · non-sterilized · shelf life NIL
Intended functions: Developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support

Family relevance: undefined

What this supports: The supplied certificate records that Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited holds manufacturing licence MFG/MD/2026/000248 under Form MD-5 and is permitted to manufacture the listed device for sale in the domestic market under Indian law and for export as per the law of the importing country. The device particulars agree with the operative MD-5 scope: non-diagnostic developmental-support software, Class B, version 1.0.0, for parents, therapists, educators and caregivers supporting children aged 0–12.

Scope and limits: A Free Sale Certificate records the Indian regulatory standing and export eligibility of the named licensed device. It is not a registration, approval or marketing authorisation in another country; each importing regulator applies its own requirements. No validity period is printed on the certificate. It does not establish diagnostic authority, clinical effectiveness, comparative superiority or the registration of any centre.

Source note: Application reference FSC/MD/2026/204866, dated 15 September 2026, is distinct from certificate FSC/MD/2026/000741. The FSC cites base licence MFG/MD/2026/000248 as issued on 20 April 2026; the supplied Form MD-5 instrument is dated 21 April 2026. Both identifiers and dates are preserved as printed. The public copies remove the visible digital-signature image while retaining the signatory name and designation; the original signed files remain in the private source set.

Source citation: Free Sale Certificate FSC/MD/2026/000741 and forwarding letter F.No FSC/MD/2026/204866, both dated 23 September 2026; original signed files inspected 24 September 2026.
Reviewed: 24 September 2026

Issuer: Bureau of Indian Standards
Licence holder: Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited
Stated validity: 3 September 2026 – 2 September 2029
Named developmental modules: AbilityScore mapping, Prognose, Everyday Therapy through TherapeuticAI, tracking and correction through Fusion

Family relevance: A documented software lifecycle makes quality responsibilities and the scope of developmental-support modules easier to examine.

What this supports: The supplied BIS licence and schedule cover the specified software design, development, verification, validation, release, deployment, maintenance, support and post-market surveillance. The schedule names developmental mapping, planning, everyday practice, tracking and correction, with school, speech, motor, Study IQ, behaviour, self-sufficiency and mainstream-inclusion readiness modules across the developmental lifecycle.

Scope and limits: The licence applies to its schedule and listed address. It is not a guarantee of clinical outcomes for a child.

Source note: This September 2026 licence supersedes the “application pending” status in older company publications.

Evidence scope: Application + issued licence
Source review conclusion: The January application records a proposed Class A classification. The issued MD-5 identifies PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 as Class B. These documents are presented in their regulatory sequence.
Application and issued MD-5 inspected; separate issued CAL not inspected.

Original application reviewed · Class B is recorded in the issued MD-5

Reported file: MD/classification/2025/150
Reported decision date: 13 April 2026
Decision source: Reported in the dossier and September handout
Application source: 8 January 2026 · proposed Class A

Family relevance: Reading the application and issued licence together helps you distinguish a requested classification from the device’s licensed classification.

What this supports: The issued MD-5 identifies the device as Class B. Company publications describe a preceding Central Licensing Authority classification decision.

Scope and limits: The locally available risk-classification form is an application proposing Class A, not the approved Class B decision. A classification decision is also distinct from a manufacturing licence.

Source note: The separate 13 April 2026 CAL/decision is described in company publications; its issued copy was not available for inspection. This review does not authenticate that separate decision.

Source citation: Risk-classification application, p1; Evidence Dossier v2, pp23–24; September handout, physical pp1 and 9; operative MD-5, p1.

## DPIIT / DIPP · Startup recognition

Canonical: https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dpiit.html
Category: Legal identity
Review status: Original reviewed
Current issuer or registry status: not independently confirmed.

DIPP8651 · Issued recognition with an updated-certificate check due

Recognition number: DIPP8651
Issued: 6 September 2017
Date printed on older certificate: Valid up to 21 November 2026
Official historical corroboration: Startup India list · 3 November 2023

Family relevance: Startup recognition explains a business credential. Your child’s care plan should be evaluated using its own clinical and service evidence.

What this supports: The supplied recognition certificate and an official historical Startup India list identify the company as a recognised startup.

Scope and limits: Recognition is distinct from a tax-exemption certificate, healthcare approval or an award. Current eligibility and status should be read from the updated certificate and applicable rules.

Source note: The older certificate uses a ₹100 crore threshold. General recognition rules changed in February 2026 to ₹200 crore; Startup India asks existing startups to download updated certificates. Do not infer current ineligibility from the old threshold.

Source citation: COR_DIPP8651.pdf, p1; Startup India list dated 3 November 2023, row 3630.
Reviewed: 15 September 2026

## ABDM / NHA · Health Facility Registry

Canonical: https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/hfr.html
Category: Centre registrations
Review status: HFR account records reviewed
All 56 complete identifiers were matched in the authenticated NHPR facility-manager dashboard on 19 September 2026. The dashboard showed 33 Approved, 14 Query Raised, 4 Submitted, 4 Rejected and 1 Query Resolved. One masked Draft is separate.

56 complete IDs matched · 33 Approved · dated NHPR workflow statuses

Registry: National Health Authority · Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission / NHPR
Live dashboard check: 19 September 2026 · authenticated facility-manager dashboard
Complete identifiers: 56 exact ID matches
Workflow statuses: 33 Approved; 14 Query Raised; 4 Submitted; 4 Rejected; 1 Query Resolved
Separate Draft: 1 masked Draft record; excluded from complete-ID total
Original workbook: 52 rows and 52 identifiers
Certificate copies: 28 unique IDs from 29 entries
Source reconciliation: All 53 earlier workbook/certificate IDs matched; 3 additional dashboard IDs

Family relevance: A facility identifier gives you a specific record to ask about when checking the centre your family will visit.

What this supports: The authenticated dashboard matched all 53 earlier inventory IDs and supplied three additional complete IDs, giving 56. Each record retains its displayed workflow status and observation date. The source workbook and certificate references remain available beside the live check.

Scope and limits: Exact HFR identifier matches and dashboard workflow statuses are separate from current centre operations, clinical quality, outcomes and other location-specific permissions. Approved applies only to the displayed NHPR workflow state; Query Raised, Submitted, Rejected and Query Resolved retain their literal meanings. One masked Draft is excluded from complete-ID totals. No replacement or cancellation relationship is inferred between additional IDs. The observation covers one authenticated NHPR account; registrations administered in other accounts have not been reconciled here.

Source note: Tirupati has two preserved IDs; Bhimavaram, Nizamabad and Khammam each have an additional dashboard ID. Exact ID matching does not establish that one record replaces or cancels another. Workbook RS flags are historical supplied fields and remain separate from dashboard statuses.

Source citation: NHPR / ABDM authenticated facility-manager dashboard, all four pages, inspected 19 September 2026. Earlier sources: All Centers With HFR.xlsx rows 2–53 and original recognitions bundle pp67–95.
Reviewed: 19 September 2026

# Pinnacle: family relevance and global context

Reviewed: 18 September 2026

A clearer starting point. A connected plan. Progress that matters in everyday life.

## Development happens across a child’s whole day.
The Nurturing Care Framework brings together health, learning, responsive caregiving and supportive environments.
Pinnacle connection: Pinnacle’s seven-stage pathway connects a developmental plan with therapy, home practice and participation goals.
Family question: How will the plan connect with our child’s day at home and school?
Source: https://www.who.int/news/item/29-06-2023-new-report-calls-for-greater-attention-to-children-s-vital-first-years

## A plan that comes home with you.
WHO describes practical caregiver skills for families of children with developmental delays or disabilities.
Pinnacle connection: The BIS schedule names Everyday Therapy through TherapeuticAI and parent/family tracking through Fusion.
Family question: What can we practise between sessions, and who will guide us?
Source: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240048836

## Clarity starts with noticing change.
CDC distinguishes ongoing developmental monitoring from formal screening and professional evaluation.
Pinnacle connection: Pinnacle’s licensed non-diagnostic software includes ability measurement and readiness tracking. This CDC reference does not validate AbilityScore as a screening test.
Family question: What is our starting point, and when will we review progress?
Source: https://www.cdc.gov/act-early/about/developmental-monitoring-and-screening.html

## Shared goals. Clear responsibilities.
NICE recommends coordinated multidisciplinary support and developmentally appropriate parent, carer or teacher involvement for autistic children and young people.
Pinnacle connection: Pinnacle describes integrated therapies and regular plan review. Families can ask how professionals share goals and who coordinates their child’s support.
Family question: Who brings the team’s observations together into one plan?
Source: https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/cg170/chapter/recommendations

## More ways to take part.
Inclusive education addresses barriers in teaching and learning environments.
Pinnacle connection: Pinnacle’s pathway works toward communication, daily living and participation. Readiness goals do not determine a child’s right to education or inclusion.
Family question: Which supports will help our child participate with others?
Source: https://www.unesco.org/en/inclusion-education

## Technology with defined responsibilities.
IMDRF describes quality management across medical-software development, deployment and maintenance.
Pinnacle connection: Pinnacle’s MD-5, BIS, quality-system and information-security records document different parts of this accountability picture.
Family question: What is the software intended for, and how are safety and changes managed?
Source: https://www.imdrf.org/documents/software-medical-device-samd-application-quality-management-system

## Selected global approaches
Cognoa · Canvas Dx: Prescription machine-learning software that assists clinicians assessing autism in children aged 18–72 months, alongside clinical assessment.
Evidence: US FDA Class II · De Novo DEN200069 · 2021
Comparison boundary: Pinnacle’s MD-5 describes non-diagnostic developmental support. These products have different intended uses.
Source: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cdrh_docs/reviews/DEN200069.pdf

EarliTec · EarliPoint: Eye tracking and software to support qualified clinicians’ autism diagnosis and assessment in children aged 16–95 months.
Evidence: US FDA Class II · K253442 · March 2026
Comparison boundary: A regulated assessment tool illustrates one part of the journey. Its clearance does not establish a complete care-service network.
Source: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cdrh_docs/pdf25/K253442.pdf

Akili · EndeavorRx: Prescription software for attention function measured by computer testing in children aged 8–17 with specified ADHD presentations, within a therapeutic programme.
Evidence: US FDA Class II · K231337 · 2023
Comparison boundary: A specific therapeutic indication should be compared on its own evidence and population, rather than equated with broad developmental support.
Source: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cdrh_docs/pdf23/K231337.pdf

Cortica: Its published model combines diagnostics, medical care, ABA, developmental therapies and mental-health counselling, involving family, home, school and community.
Evidence: Provider’s published service model
Comparison boundary: Integrated child-development care exists internationally. Compare actual coordination, local availability and evidence for the services your child needs.
Source: https://www.corticacare.com/whole-child

CentralReach · CanaryBI: Its November 2025 release reports over 5 billion clinical and financial data points in CanaryBI.
Evidence: Company-reported dataset volume · 2025
Comparison boundary: This mixed clinical/financial count and Pinnacle’s structured-record count use different definitions. They do not establish a like-for-like ranking.
Source: https://centralreach.com/blog/centralreach-publishes-semi-annual-2025-autism-and-idd-care-market-report-the-industry-benchmark-for-growth-and-innovation/

This is a targeted comparison, not proof of global exclusivity or superiority.

What does Pinnacle’s 2.7 billion+ data-point figure mean?
The September 2026 company handout reports 2.7 billion+ structured platform records, based on database rows/events with a 17 July 2026 cutoff. Examples include session entries, assessment observations and technique ratings. The number is not a count of unique children, independent trial observations or verified AI-training examples.

Does this establish the world’s largest child-development dataset?
No comparable worldwide ranking is established. For example, CentralReach reports over 5 billion clinical and financial data points, using a different counting basis. A valid comparison would need common definitions, dates, populations, data quality and permitted uses.

Does the MD-5 licence approve the entire child-development lifecycle?
The MD-5 names PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 and defined non-diagnostic functions for ages 0–12. The broader BIS schedule lists software processes and developmental-support modules across the journey. These instruments establish different scopes; neither guarantees outcomes or certifies global exclusivity.

Do WHO, UNICEF, CDC, NICE or UNESCO endorse Pinnacle?
No endorsement is established by the references on this page. Their guidance explains why monitoring, coordinated support, caregiver participation and inclusion matter. Pinnacle’s own documents must separately establish what Pinnacle provides.

What is the purpose of the Pinnacle developmental pathway?
Pinnacle’s purpose is to help children grow toward self-sufficiency and participation in mainstream life, with the support and accommodations each child needs. Its tagline is “Every child deserves a wonderful life.” The described approach connects ability measurement, child-specific planning, coordinated intervention, everyday practice, tracking, correction and reassessment. Individual outcomes vary.

What do 17 domains, 79 abilities and 349 skills mean?
Pinnacle describes these as different layers of its developmental framework: 17 domains, 79 abilities and 349 skills, with 591 observations and AbilityScore on a 0–1000 scale. The totals belong to Pinnacle’s architecture, not a WHO-defined numerical hierarchy. Individual plans select relevant priorities. The earlier Whitebook used 344 skills across six domains; validation of an earlier version should not be automatically transferred to the newer framework.

How do daily practice and monthly review connect?
The company sources describe 7–9 daily techniques selected for the child’s programme, human feedback through the Fusion tracking and correction module, and monthly AbilityScore refresh. The care team should explain the child-specific goals, practice guidance, review schedule and any adjustments. This is a programme description, not a guaranteed outcome.

How do ICD-11, ICF, ICHI and SNOMED CT relate to PinnacleAI®?
Pinnacle’s dossier describes architecture and mappings using WHO’s ICD-11, ICF and ICHI, alongside SNOMED CT terminology from SNOMED International. Their roles are health information, functioning and participation, interventions, and consistent clinical meaning. Correct implementation can support interoperability; an item-by-item mapping audit was not supplied. Alignment is separate from endorsement, clinical validation and the licensed device’s intended use.

Does Pinnacle focus on a diagnosis or on everyday-life goals?
Families may arrive with questions about autism, ADHD, communication, sensory processing, movement, learning or other developmental concerns. Pinnacle’s stated purpose centres on the capabilities that help each child grow toward self-sufficiency and participate in mainstream life, with the support and accommodations they need. These are examples of individual goals, not promised results. Professional assessment identifies the support appropriate to each child; diagnosis and medical care remain important where indicated. The licensed software’s scope is non-diagnostic developmental support for ages 0–12, not treatment of every condition.

Is PinnacleAI® certified as sovereign-grade or authorised worldwide?
The reviewed documents do not establish a sovereign-grade certification or worldwide market authorisation. Pinnacle describes an architecture intended for population-scale developmental support. A specific deployment needs documented local control and governance, validated interoperability, applicable permissions, operational capacity and evidence of performance for that population. MD-5 and BIS provide the particular scopes shown in their records.

Are parents and caregivers named in the MD-5 intended use?
Yes. The MD-5 annexure states that PinnacleAI® GPT-OS is intended to assist parents, therapists, educators and caregivers through developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support for ages 0–12. This explicitly includes family users of the licensed software. It does not confer professional therapist credentials or register homes as therapy centres; worldwide exclusivity has not been established.

# Pinnacle scale: figures, definitions and evidence

Reviewed: 19 September 2026

## 2.7 billion+ — Structured developmental records
Independent CA factual finding · SRS 4400
A large record system can preserve observations across a child’s developmental journey, supporting continuity and review.
Counting basis: 2,700,000,000+ records in the SRS 4400 findings at 17 July 2026 (annexure p3, item 5). SAE 3000 separately covers a 2.5 billion+ floor.
Evidence boundary: Session entries, assessment observations, technique ratings and other structured events. The evidence does not identify every record as an AI-training example or establish clinical effectiveness.
Sources: operating-metrics, srs4400, sae3000

## 31 million+ — Cumulative services recorded
Independent CA reports · defined count
The useful family question is how the experience recorded across services informs a clear plan and review for your child.
Counting basis: 31,052,382 in the SRS 4400 findings (annexure p3, item 1), at 17 July 2026. SAE 3000 provides limited assurance over the 31 million+ floor.
Evidence boundary: The defined total includes assessments, screenings and parent training. It is not established as 31 million successful one-to-one therapy sessions; service volume and clinical success are separate measures.
Sources: operating-metrics, sae3000, srs4400

## 1.3 lakh — Early-intervention technique repository
Management update · inventory not inspected
A technique library is useful when a practitioner selects and adapts activities to a child’s goals, interests and everyday routines.
Counting basis: 130,000 techniques: management-supplied update received 18 September 2026. The 7 September handout reports an earlier 90,000+ library.
Evidence boundary: The updated repository count has not been reconciled to a dated inventory extract. The reviewed UDIN reports do not establish this figure, and technique count does not mean 130,000 separately validated interventions.
Sources: operating-metrics, september-handout

## 7.9 lakh+ — Beneficiary / family registrations
Independent CA reports · defined count
Behind each registration is a family seeking support. A family’s own goals and progress reviews remain the measure that matters to them.
Counting basis: 792,614 unique beneficiary/family registrations in SRS 4400 (annexure p3, item 2), at 17 July 2026. SAE 3000 covers the 790,000+ floor.
Evidence boundary: This is the defined registration measure. It is not a count of unique children with independently verified outcomes, and it does not itself measure family empowerment.
Sources: operating-metrics, sae3000, srs4400

## 70+ — Countries of family origin reported
Company-reported international reach
Families may connect with developmental support across borders, including through remote delivery where available.
Counting basis: Company-reported international reach in the July 2026 dossier, including remote delivery.
Evidence boundary: Countries of family origin are different from countries with a physical Pinnacle centre. The reviewed practitioner reports do not establish this country count.
Sources: operating-metrics, dossier

## 70+ — Centres in the reported network
Network scope distinguished
A network becomes relevant locally. Find your centre, its facility identifier and the source behind each listed document.
Counting basis: Network figure reported in the September handout. The practitioner-report criteria separately identify 49 operational centres at 17 July 2026.
Evidence boundary: Network size, operational-centre counts and HFR identifiers are different measures. On 19 September 2026, 56 complete IDs matched in the NHPR dashboard and 33 displayed Approved; other workflow statuses and one masked Draft remain separate. An HFR record does not establish clinical outcomes or replace location-specific permissions.
Sources: hfr, operating-metrics, srs4400

What does my child’s AbilityScore® mean?

https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/guides/abilityscore.html

Language: en-IN

Updated: 2026-09-24

AbilityScore® is Pinnacle’s structured description of a child’s present developmental abilities. Read it alongside the assessed skills, everyday observations and the care team’s explanation. The useful question is: what can my child do now, and what should we work on next?

Start with abilities, then look at the number

Pinnacle’s current company descriptions organise development into 17 domains, 79 abilities and 349 skills. These are different levels of the framework, rather than interchangeable counts. AbilityScore® presents a structured starting point for discussing the child’s strengths and next priorities.

The reviewed dossier describes clinical AbilityScore® as clinician-administered and clinically governed. A parent’s observations contribute valuable context; a questionnaire and a clinical assessment should be explained as different parts of the process.

Source: Pinnacle company walkthrough — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/sovereign-walkthrough.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

Read the overall profile and the focused reports

The supplied September examples contain an overall AbilityScore® / TherapeuticAI® report and seven focused readiness reports: speech, behaviour, motor, study/IQ, school, self-sufficiency and mainstream readiness. Each view gives the family and care team a way to discuss a different part of daily life.

The Study/IQ Readiness report title does not establish it as an independent IQ test. A readiness label is not a diagnosis or a promise of admission to school.

Source: Report-format review and eight-report guide — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/#report-explorer

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

Ask what sits behind the score

Look for who assessed the child, when the assessment happened and the situations the observations describe. Ask the care team to show the skills that inform the profile and connect them to what the child does at home, in learning and with other people.

For example, a family might ask: ‘Which communication ability are we working on, and what change would we notice during our usual day?’ This is a discussion prompt, not an interpretation of any child’s score.

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

Source: Report-format review and eight-report guide — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/#report-explorer

Compare your child’s progress over time

The supplied September report examples display the overall score and readiness indices on a 0–1000 scale. Older methodology material describes readiness indices on a 0–100 scale. Confirm the report version and scale before comparing results; do not treat different versions as directly equivalent.

Pinnacle’s workflow describes monthly reassessment. Ask what has changed in everyday life, which goals remain useful and how the next plan follows from the review. The report’s presentation version is separate from the medical-device software version.

Source: Pinnacle company walkthrough — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/sovereign-walkthrough.html

Source: Report-format review and eight-report guide — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/#report-explorer

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

Understand the stage of the research

The methodology preprint describes development and preliminary measurement findings. The separately published external-validation protocol sets out planned research; it is not a completed validation result. The evidence library links both records so families and professionals can read what each one establishes.

A score helps organise a conversation. It does not define a child’s worth, guarantee independence or determine their right to belong and participate.

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

Source: AbilityScore® external-validation protocol — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/external-validation.html

Questions to take to your care team

Which abilities and daily-life priorities does this profile highlight?

Who completed the assessment, using which report version and scale?

What will we practise, and what change will we look for at the next review?

Is AbilityScore® a diagnosis?

PinnacleAI® is described in the reviewed MD-5 as non-diagnostic developmental-support software. AbilityScore® should be discussed as a developmental ability profile, not used as a disease diagnosis.

Can I compare two different report versions?

Ask the care team to confirm the scale and instrument version first. The reviewed September reports and older methodology material describe different readiness-index scales; a direct comparison is not established by those sources.

Clinical explanations reviewed by the Pinnacle Clinical Committee. Confirmation recorded: 19 September 2026. Prepared with AI editorial assistance.

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS: non-diagnostic developmental support, ages 0–12. Plans and outcomes are individual.

నా బిడ్డ AbilityScore® ఏం చెబుతుంది?

https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/guides/te/abilityscore.html

Language: te-IN

Updated: 2026-09-24

AbilityScore® మీ బిడ్డ ప్రస్తుతం చేయగల పనులు, సామర్థ్యాలను ఒక క్రమంలో చూపించే Pinnacle విధానం. స్కోర్‌తో పాటు చూసిన స్కిల్స్, ఇంట్లో మీరు గమనించిన విషయాలు, కేర్ టీమ్ వివరణను కలిపి అర్థం చేసుకోండి. ముఖ్యమైన ప్రశ్న: నా బిడ్డ ఇప్పుడు ఏం చేయగలదు? తర్వాత దేనిపై పని చేయాలి?

ముందు సామర్థ్యాలను చూడండి; తర్వాత స్కోర్‌ను చూడండి

Pinnacle ప్రస్తుతం వివరించే ఫ్రేమ్‌వర్క్‌లో 17 డొమైన్లు, 79 సామర్థ్యాలు, 349 స్కిల్స్ ఉన్నాయి. ఇవి ఒకే విషయానికి వేర్వేరు లెక్కలు కావు; ఒక్కో స్థాయిలో వివరాలను చూపిస్తాయి. బిడ్డ బలాలు, తర్వాత ఏం నేర్చుకోవాలో చర్చించడానికి AbilityScore® ఒక ప్రారంభం.

పరిశీలించిన Evidence Dossier ప్రకారం క్లినికల్ AbilityScore® అనేది క్లినీషియన్ చేసే Assessment; ఇది క్లినికల్ పర్యవేక్షణలో జరుగుతుంది. ఇంట్లో తల్లిదండ్రులు గమనించే విషయాలు ఉపయోగపడతాయి. తల్లిదండ్రుల ప్రశ్నావళి, క్లినికల్ Assessment వేర్వేరు భాగాలని టీమ్ స్పష్టంగా వివరించాలి.

Source: Pinnacle company walkthrough — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/sovereign-walkthrough.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

మొత్తం ప్రొఫైల్‌తో పాటు ఒక్కో రిపోర్ట్‌ను చూడండి

అందించిన సెప్టెంబర్ నమూనాల్లో మొత్తం AbilityScore® / TherapeuticAI® రిపోర్ట్‌తో పాటు ఏడు Readiness రిపోర్టులు ఉన్నాయి: Speech, Behavior, Motor, Study/IQ, School, Self-Sufficiency, Mainstream Readiness. రోజువారీ జీవితంలోని ఒక్కో అంశం గురించి కుటుంబం, కేర్ టీమ్ కలిసి మాట్లాడుకోవడానికి ఇవి ఉపయోగపడతాయి.

Study/IQ Readiness అనే పేరు ఒక్కటే, ఇది ప్రత్యేక IQ టెస్ట్ అని చెప్పడానికి సరిపోదు. Readiness అనే పేరు వ్యాధి నిర్ధారణ కాదు; స్కూల్ అడ్మిషన్‌కు హామీ కూడా కాదు.

Source: Report-format review and eight-report guide — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/#report-explorer

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

ఈ స్కోర్ వెనుక ఏం ఉందో అడగండి

Assessment ఎవరు చేశారు? ఎప్పుడు చేశారు? ఏ సందర్భాల్లో బిడ్డను గమనించారు? ఈ వివరాలు చూడండి. ప్రొఫైల్‌కు ఆధారమైన స్కిల్స్‌ను చూపించి, ఇంట్లో, నేర్చుకునేటప్పుడు, ఇతరులతో ఉన్నప్పుడు బిడ్డ చేసే పనులతో కలిపి వివరించమని టీమ్‌ను అడగండి.

ఉదాహరణకు ఇలా అడగవచ్చు: ‘ఇప్పుడు ఏ కమ్యూనికేషన్ స్కిల్ మీద పని చేస్తున్నాం? రోజువారీ పనుల్లో ఏ మార్పు కనిపిస్తే అది అర్థమవుతుంది?’ ఇది మాట్లాడుకోవడానికి ఒక ఉదాహరణ మాత్రమే; ఏ బిడ్డ స్కోర్‌కూ వివరణ కాదు.

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

మీ బిడ్డలో వచ్చిన మార్పును కాలక్రమంలో చూడండి

అందించిన సెప్టెంబర్ రిపోర్టుల్లో మొత్తం స్కోర్, Readiness సూచికలు 0–1000 స్కేల్‌లో ఉన్నాయి. పాత మెథడాలజీ పత్రంలో Readiness సూచికలకు 0–100 స్కేల్ ఉంది. రెండు రిపోర్టులను పోల్చే ముందు వెర్షన్, స్కేల్ ఒకటేనా అని తెలుసుకోండి; వేర్వేరు వెర్షన్లను నేరుగా ఒకేలా పోల్చకండి.

Pinnacle వివరించిన విధానంలో ప్రతి నెలా మళ్లీ Assessment ఉంటుంది. రోజువారీ జీవితంలో ఏం మారింది, ఏ లక్ష్యాలు ఇంకా అవసరం, ఆ రివ్యూ ఆధారంగా తర్వాతి Plan ఎలా మారుతుందో అడగండి. రిపోర్ట్ ప్రెజెంటేషన్ వెర్షన్, మెడికల్ డివైస్ సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్ వెర్షన్ వేర్వేరు.

Source: Pinnacle company walkthrough — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/sovereign-walkthrough.html

Source: Report-format review and eight-report guide — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/#report-explorer

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

పరిశోధన ఏ దశలో ఉందో తెలుసుకోండి

మెథడాలజీ preprintలో విధానం ఎలా రూపొందింది, మొదట కనిపించిన కొలత ఫలితాలు వివరించారు. వేరుగా ప్రచురించిన external-validation protocol చేయాలనుకున్న పరిశోధనను వివరిస్తుంది; అది పూర్తయిన validation ఫలితం కాదు. రెండింటి మూల పత్రాలూ ఆధారాల లైబ్రరీలో ఉన్నాయి.

స్కోర్ చర్చకు ఒక ఆధారం. అది బిడ్డ విలువను నిర్ణయించదు, స్వతంత్రంగా జీవిస్తారని హామీ ఇవ్వదు. అందరితో కలిసి ఉండే హక్కు ఏ స్కోర్‌పైనా ఆధారపడదు.

Source: AbilityScore® external-validation protocol — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/external-validation.html

మీ కేర్ టీమ్‌ను అడగాల్సిన ప్రశ్నలు

ఈ ప్రొఫైల్‌లో ఏ సామర్థ్యాలు, రోజువారీ లక్ష్యాలకు ప్రాధాన్యం ఉంది?

Assessment ఎవరు చేశారు? ఏ రిపోర్ట్ వెర్షన్, స్కేల్ వాడారు?

ఏం Practice చేయాలి? తర్వాతి రివ్యూలో ఏ మార్పును చూడాలి?

AbilityScore® వ్యాధిని నిర్ధారిస్తుందా?

పరిశీలించిన MD-5లో PinnacleAI®ను వ్యాధి నిర్ధారణ చేయని developmental-support సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్‌గా పేర్కొన్నారు. AbilityScore®ను బిడ్డ సామర్థ్యాల ప్రొఫైల్‌గా అర్థం చేసుకోవాలి; వ్యాధి నిర్ధారణగా వాడకూడదు.

వేర్వేరు వెర్షన్ల రిపోర్టులను పోల్చవచ్చా?

ముందుగా స్కేల్, వెర్షన్‌ను కేర్ టీమ్‌తో నిర్ధారించుకోండి. సెప్టెంబర్ నమూనాలు, పాత మెథడాలజీ పత్రం వేర్వేరు Readiness స్కేల్స్‌ను వివరిస్తున్నాయి. వాటిని నేరుగా పోల్చవచ్చని ఈ ఆధారాలు నిర్ధారించడం లేదు.

ఈ వివరణలను Pinnacle Clinical Committee సమీక్షించింది. సమీక్ష పూర్తయినట్లు 19 సెప్టెంబర్ 2026న నిర్ధారించారు. రచనలో AI సహాయం తీసుకున్నాం.

AI సహాయంతో చేసిన తెలుగు అనువాదం. మూల ఆధారాలతో పోల్చి, సహజమైన భాష కోసం సంపాదకీయ పరిశీలన చేశాం; మానవ భాషా నిపుణుల సమీక్ష ఇంకా జరగలేదు.

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS: 0–12 ఏళ్ల పిల్లల డెవలప్‌మెంట్‌కు సపోర్ట్ ఇచ్చే సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్; వ్యాధి నిర్ధారణ చేయదు. Plan, ఫలితాలు ఒక్కో బిడ్డకు వేరుగా ఉంటాయి.

మూల పత్రాలు కావాలన్నా, ఈ వివరణ గురించి సందేహం ఉన్నా Sourabh Sashank (Lead PinnacleAI®)ను సంప్రదించండి: care@pinnacleblooms.org లేదా 9100 181 181.

मेरे बच्चे का AbilityScore® क्या बताता है?

https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/guides/hi/abilityscore.html

Language: hi-IN

Updated: 2026-09-24

AbilityScore® बच्चे की मौजूदा विकास संबंधी क्षमताओं को एक व्यवस्थित रूप में दिखाने का Pinnacle का तरीका है। इसे जाँचे गए कौशल, रोज़मर्रा के अनुभवों और केयर टीम की व्याख्या के साथ पढ़ें। असली सवाल है: मेरा बच्चा अभी क्या कर सकता है और आगे किस पर काम करना चाहिए?

पहले क्षमताएँ समझें, फिर स्कोर देखें

Pinnacle के वर्तमान विवरण में विकास को 17 डोमेन, 79 क्षमताओं और 349 कौशलों में व्यवस्थित किया गया है। ये अलग-अलग स्तर हैं, एक ही चीज़ की अलग गिनती नहीं। AbilityScore® बच्चे की ताकत और अगली प्राथमिकताओं पर बात शुरू करने का एक आधार देता है।

जाँचे गए Evidence Dossier में क्लिनिकल AbilityScore® को क्लिनिशियन द्वारा किया जाने वाला, चिकित्सकीय निगरानी में संचालित आकलन बताया गया है। माता-पिता के अनुभव महत्वपूर्ण संदर्भ देते हैं। अभिभावक की प्रश्नावली और क्लिनिकल आकलन को प्रक्रिया के अलग हिस्सों के रूप में समझाया जाना चाहिए।

Source: Pinnacle company walkthrough — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/sovereign-walkthrough.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

पूरी प्रोफाइल के साथ अलग-अलग रिपोर्ट भी पढ़ें

दिए गए सितंबर के उदाहरणों में एक पूरी AbilityScore® / TherapeuticAI® रिपोर्ट और सात Readiness रिपोर्ट हैं: Speech, Behavior, Motor, Study/IQ, School, Self-Sufficiency और Mainstream Readiness। ये परिवार और केयर टीम को रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी के अलग पहलुओं पर बात करने में मदद करती हैं।

Study/IQ Readiness नाम अपने आप में इसे स्वतंत्र रूप से स्थापित IQ टेस्ट नहीं बनाता। Readiness का नाम किसी रोग का निदान या स्कूल में प्रवेश का वादा नहीं है।

Source: Report-format review and eight-report guide — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/#report-explorer

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

पूछें कि स्कोर किन बातों पर आधारित है

देखें कि आकलन किसने किया, कब किया और बच्चे को किन परिस्थितियों में देखा गया। केयर टीम से उन कौशलों को समझाने के लिए कहें जिनसे प्रोफाइल बनी है। उन्हें घर, सीखने और दूसरे लोगों के साथ बच्चे के अनुभवों से जोड़कर समझें।

मसलन, परिवार पूछ सकता है: ‘अभी हम बातचीत के किस कौशल पर काम कर रहे हैं, और रोज़ के कामों में कौन-सा बदलाव दिखेगा?’ यह बातचीत का एक उदाहरण है, किसी बच्चे के स्कोर की व्याख्या नहीं।

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

Source: Report-format review and eight-report guide — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/#report-explorer

समय के साथ अपने बच्चे की प्रगति देखें

दिए गए सितंबर के उदाहरणों में कुल स्कोर और Readiness सूचकांक 0–1000 के पैमाने पर हैं। पुराने मेथडोलॉजी दस्तावेज़ में Readiness सूचकांकों का पैमाना 0–100 है। तुलना से पहले रिपोर्ट का संस्करण और पैमाना समझें; अलग संस्करणों को सीधे एक जैसा न मानें।

Pinnacle की बताई प्रक्रिया में हर महीने दोबारा आकलन शामिल है। पूछें कि रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी में क्या बदला, कौन-से लक्ष्य अभी ज़रूरी हैं और समीक्षा के बाद अगला प्लान कैसे बदलेगा। रिपोर्ट के प्रस्तुति संस्करण और मेडिकल-डिवाइस सॉफ्टवेयर के संस्करण अलग हैं।

Source: Pinnacle company walkthrough — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/sovereign-walkthrough.html

Source: Report-format review and eight-report guide — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/#report-explorer

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

समझें कि शोध अभी किस चरण में है

मेथडोलॉजी preprint बताता है कि मापने का तरीका कैसे विकसित हुआ और शुरुआती निष्कर्ष क्या थे। अलग से प्रकाशित external-validation protocol नियोजित शोध की रूपरेखा है; यह पूरी हो चुकी validation का परिणाम नहीं है। दोनों मूल रिकॉर्ड प्रमाण लाइब्रेरी में पढ़े जा सकते हैं।

स्कोर बातचीत को व्यवस्थित करने का एक आधार है। यह बच्चे का महत्व तय नहीं करता, आत्मनिर्भरता की गारंटी नहीं देता और समाज में शामिल होने के उसके अधिकार को निर्धारित नहीं करता।

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

Source: AbilityScore® external-validation protocol — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/external-validation.html

अपनी केयर टीम से पूछने के सवाल

यह प्रोफाइल किन क्षमताओं और रोज़मर्रा के लक्ष्यों को प्राथमिकता देती है?

आकलन किसने किया और रिपोर्ट का कौन-सा संस्करण व पैमाना इस्तेमाल हुआ?

हमें किसका अभ्यास करना है और अगली समीक्षा में कौन-सा बदलाव देखना है?

क्या AbilityScore® किसी रोग का निदान है?

जाँचे गए MD-5 में PinnacleAI® को non-diagnostic developmental-support सॉफ्टवेयर बताया गया है। AbilityScore® को विकास संबंधी क्षमताओं की प्रोफाइल के रूप में समझें, किसी रोग के निदान के रूप में नहीं।

क्या अलग संस्करणों की रिपोर्ट की तुलना कर सकते हैं?

पहले केयर टीम से पैमाने और संस्करण की पुष्टि करें। सितंबर के उदाहरणों और पुराने मेथडोलॉजी दस्तावेज़ में Readiness सूचकांकों के अलग पैमाने हैं। ये स्रोत उनकी सीधी तुलना स्थापित नहीं करते।

इन जानकारियों की समीक्षा Pinnacle Clinical Committee ने की है। समीक्षा पूरी होने की पुष्टि 19 सितंबर 2026 को दर्ज की गई। लेखन में AI की सहायता ली गई है।

AI की सहायता से किया गया हिन्दी अनुवाद। स्रोतों से मिलान और सहज भाषा के लिए संपादकीय जाँच की गई है; मानव भाषा विशेषज्ञ की समीक्षा अभी नहीं हुई है।

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS: 0–12 वर्ष के बच्चों के विकास में सहायता के लिए; रोग की पहचान या निदान नहीं करता। हर बच्चे का प्लान और उसके परिणाम अलग हो सकते हैं।

मूल दस्तावेज़ या इस जानकारी के बारे में किसी सवाल के लिए Sourabh Sashank (Lead PinnacleAI®) से संपर्क करें: care@pinnacleblooms.org या 9100 181 181.

From assessment to everyday practice

https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/guides/everyday-practice.html

Language: en-IN

Updated: 2026-09-24

Pinnacle’s documented approach connects an assessment to a child-specific plan, guided daily activities, feedback and reassessment. Parents, caregivers, educators and therapists contribute different observations. The aim is a shared direction that can be reviewed and adjusted as the child’s needs change.

Agree what matters in your child’s day

Begin with present abilities, interests and the situations where support would help. Connect the assessment to practical priorities such as communicating a need, taking part in a routine or participating with others. Ask who will explain the plan and coordinate the next review.

The MD-5 intended use names parents, therapists, educators and caregivers. The dossier describes a Personal Development Kernel: the child’s measurements, history, goals and responses stay connected to inform later recommendations. Software supports human judgement and care-team coordination.

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

Ask for activities you can understand

The September handout describes 7–9 techniques selected for the daily programme and a four-day therapy forecast. The methodology preprint also describes preparing programmes four days ahead. These are source descriptions; the agreed plan determines what is appropriate for the individual child.

Ask the team to show each selected activity, explain the ability it supports and agree where it fits in your routine. A list of technique names becomes useful when the family understands what to do, why it was chosen and how to ask for help.

Source: September 2026 handout — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/september-handout.html

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

Connect professional support with home practice

Parent-guided practice brings an agreed activity into familiar situations. It is part of the described care pathway, with professional support and human oversight. A parent's participation does not itself create a professional therapy qualification.

Ask which observations to share, who can see the child’s programme and how consent and access are managed. The dossier describes parental-consent controls and role-based access for the people involved in the child’s support.

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Let feedback change the plan

If an activity is difficult to follow or does not engage the child, bring that observation to the team. The methodology describes technique ratings feeding the child-specific record; the BIS schedule names the family, caregiver, therapist and clinical tracking and correction Fusion Module.

A useful discussion might be: ‘This activity was easier in a quiet room; what should we keep or change?’ The care team can review the setting, activity or support. This is an illustrative conversation, not a prescribed intervention or patient result.

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

Use the monthly review to agree what comes next

The company walkthrough describes monthly reassessment. Compare the child’s current abilities with earlier assessments, check everyday examples and ask how the next priorities follow from the evidence. Confirm that the report versions and scales are comparable.

The seven-stage direction is measurement, a child-specific plan, coordinated support, home practice, tracking and correction, reassessment, and growing independence and participation. Readiness indices help organise discussion; they do not promise a fixed date for school entry or independence.

Source: Pinnacle company walkthrough — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/sovereign-walkthrough.html

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

Questions to take to your care team

What is the purpose of each activity in this child’s plan?

Can someone demonstrate it and explain what feedback to record?

What did the last review change, and when will we review the plan again?

Does every child follow the same daily programme?

The documented approach describes selecting activities for the child’s abilities and goals. The September handout’s programme counts describe that source; the care team should explain the individual plan and any changes.

What should a monthly review include?

The described workflow connects reassessment with earlier abilities, everyday observations, difficulties and the next priorities. Families can ask how those findings change the plan, while confirming the report version and scale.

Clinical explanations reviewed by the Pinnacle Clinical Committee. Confirmation recorded: 19 September 2026. Prepared with AI editorial assistance.

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS: non-diagnostic developmental support, ages 0–12. Plans and outcomes are individual.

For source documents or a question about this explanation, contact Sourabh Sashank (Lead PinnacleAI®) at care@pinnacleblooms.org or 9100 181 181.

Assessment నుంచి రోజువారీ Practice వరకు

https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/guides/te/everyday-practice.html

Language: te-IN

Updated: 2026-09-24

Pinnacle వివరించే విధానంలో Assessment నుంచి బిడ్డకు సరిపోయే Plan, మార్గదర్శకత్వంతో రోజువారీ Practice, Feedback, మళ్లీ Assessment వరకు అన్ని దశలూ కలుస్తాయి. తల్లిదండ్రులు, కేర్‌గివర్లు, టీచర్లు, థెరపిస్టులు తాము గమనించిన విషయాలు పంచుకుంటారు. బిడ్డ అవసరాలకు తగ్గట్టు Planను మార్చుకుంటూ ముందుకు వెళ్లడం లక్ష్యం.

బిడ్డ రోజువారీ జీవితంలో ఏది ముఖ్యమో కలిసి నిర్ణయించండి

బిడ్డ ఇప్పుడు చేయగల పనులు, ఇష్టాలు, ఏ సందర్భాల్లో సపోర్ట్ అవసరమో అక్కడి నుంచి మొదలుపెట్టండి. తన అవసరం చెప్పడం, రోజువారీ పనిలో పాల్గొనడం, ఇతరులతో కలవడం వంటి లక్ష్యాలతో Assessmentను కలపండి. Planను ఎవరు వివరిస్తారు, తర్వాతి రివ్యూను ఎవరు సమన్వయం చేస్తారో అడగండి.

MD-5లో తల్లిదండ్రులు, థెరపిస్టులు, టీచర్లు, కేర్‌గివర్లను వినియోగదారులుగా పేర్కొన్నారు. Dossierలో Personal Development Kernel గురించి ఉంది: బిడ్డ కొలతలు, చరిత్ర, లక్ష్యాలు, Practiceకు స్పందన ఒకదానితో ఒకటి కలిసి ఉండి, తర్వాతి సూచనలకు ఉపయోగపడతాయి. నిర్ణయాలు తీసుకునే టీమ్‌కు సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్ తోడ్పడుతుంది.

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

మీకు స్పష్టంగా అర్థమయ్యే Activities అడగండి

సెప్టెంబర్ handoutలో రోజువారీ ప్రోగ్రామ్‌కు 7–9 టెక్నిక్స్, నాలుగు రోజుల Therapy forecast వివరించారు. మెథడాలజీ preprint కూడా నాలుగు రోజుల ముందే ప్రోగ్రామ్ సిద్ధం చేయడం గురించి చెబుతుంది. ఇవి ఆ పత్రాల్లోని వివరాలు; మీ బిడ్డకు ఏది సరిపోతుందో వ్యక్తిగత Planలో నిర్ణయించాలి.

ఎంచుకున్న Activity ఎలా చేయాలో చూపించమని, ఏ సామర్థ్యానికి ఉపయోగపడుతుందో వివరించమని అడగండి. మీ రోజులో ఎప్పుడు చేయాలో కలిసి నిర్ణయించండి. ఏం చేయాలి, ఎందుకు చేయాలి, అవసరమైతే ఎవరిని అడగాలి అనే Clarity ఉంటేనే టెక్నిక్స్ జాబితా ఉపయోగపడుతుంది.

Source: September 2026 handout — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/september-handout.html

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

నిపుణుల సపోర్ట్‌ను ఇంట్లో Practiceతో కలపండి

తల్లిదండ్రుల మార్గదర్శకత్వంలో Practice అంటే టీమ్‌తో అంగీకరించిన Activityని తెలిసిన రోజువారీ సందర్భాల్లో చేయడం. ఈ ప్రయాణంలో నిపుణుల సపోర్ట్, పర్యవేక్షణ ఉంటాయి. ఇందులో పాల్గొన్నంత మాత్రాన తల్లిదండ్రులకు ప్రొఫెషనల్ థెరపిస్ట్ అర్హత వచ్చినట్లు కాదు.

ఏ విషయాలను గమనించి పంచుకోవాలి? బిడ్డ ప్రోగ్రామ్‌ను ఎవరు చూడగలరు? అనుమతి, యాక్సెస్ ఎలా నిర్వహిస్తారు? ఇవి అడగండి. తల్లిదండ్రుల సమ్మతి, ఒక్కొక్కరి పాత్రను బట్టి యాక్సెస్ ఇవ్వడం గురించి Dossier వివరిస్తుంది.

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

మీ Feedbackతో Planను మెరుగుపరచండి

Activity చేయడం కష్టంగా ఉన్నా, బిడ్డ ఆసక్తి చూపకపోయినా ఆ విషయం టీమ్‌కు చెప్పండి. టెక్నిక్స్‌కు ఇచ్చే Ratings బిడ్డ రికార్డులో చేరతాయని మెథడాలజీ పత్రం చెబుతుంది. BIS షెడ్యూల్‌లో కుటుంబం, కేర్‌గివర్లు, థెరపిస్టులు, క్లినికల్ టీమ్‌తో Tracking, Correction చేసే Fusion Module ఉంది.

ఉదాహరణకు: ‘ప్రశాంతమైన గదిలో ఈ Activity సులభంగా జరిగింది; ఏం అలాగే ఉంచాలి, ఏం మార్చాలి?’ అని అడగవచ్చు. పరిసరాలు, Activity, సపోర్ట్‌ను టీమ్ సమీక్షించవచ్చు. ఇది మాట్లాడుకునే విధానానికి ఉదాహరణ; సూచించిన చికిత్స లేదా నిజమైన కేసు ఫలితం కాదు.

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

నెలవారీ రివ్యూలో తర్వాతి దిశ నిర్ణయించండి

Company walkthroughలో ప్రతి నెలా మళ్లీ Assessment చేయడం వివరించారు. మునుపటి Assessmentతో ఇప్పుడు బిడ్డ చేయగల పనులను పోల్చండి, రోజువారీ ఉదాహరణలు చర్చించండి, తర్వాతి ప్రాధాన్యాలు ఎలా నిర్ణయించారో అడగండి. రిపోర్ట్ వెర్షన్లు, స్కేల్స్ పోల్చడానికి సరిపోతాయో నిర్ధారించుకోండి.

ఏడు దశలు: సామర్థ్యాలను తెలుసుకోవడం, బిడ్డకు సరిపోయే Plan, టీమ్ సపోర్ట్, ఇంట్లో Practice, Tracking–మార్పులు, మళ్లీ Assessment, తన పనులు తాను చేసుకుంటూ అందరితో కలవడం. Readiness సూచికలు చర్చకు ఉపయోగపడతాయి; స్కూల్‌లో చేరే తేదీకి లేదా స్వతంత్రంగా జీవించడానికి హామీ ఇవ్వవు.

Source: Pinnacle company walkthrough — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/sovereign-walkthrough.html

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

మీ కేర్ టీమ్‌ను అడగాల్సిన ప్రశ్నలు

మా బిడ్డ Planలో ఒక్కో Activity ఎందుకు ఉంది?

ఎలా చేయాలో చూపించి, ఏ Feedback ఇవ్వాలో చెప్పగలరా?

గత రివ్యూ వల్ల Planలో ఏం మారింది? మళ్లీ ఎప్పుడు చూస్తాం?

పిల్లలందరికీ ఒకే రోజువారీ ప్రోగ్రామ్ ఉంటుందా?

వివరించిన విధానం ప్రకారం బిడ్డ సామర్థ్యాలు, లక్ష్యాలకు అనుగుణంగా Activities ఎంచుకుంటారు. సెప్టెంబర్ handoutలో ఉన్న లెక్కలు ఆ పత్రంలోని వివరాలు. వ్యక్తిగత Plan, దానిలో మార్పులను కేర్ టీమ్ వివరించాలి.

నెలవారీ రివ్యూలో ఏం చూడాలి?

వివరించిన విధానంలో మళ్లీ Assessment చేయడం, మునుపటి సామర్థ్యాలు, రోజువారీ అనుభవాలు, కష్టాలు, తర్వాతి ప్రాధాన్యాలు కలుస్తాయి. రిపోర్ట్ వెర్షన్, స్కేల్‌ను నిర్ధారించుకుని, ఈ వివరాల వల్ల Plan ఎలా మారుతుందో అడగవచ్చు.

ఈ వివరణలను Pinnacle Clinical Committee సమీక్షించింది. సమీక్ష పూర్తయినట్లు 19 సెప్టెంబర్ 2026న నిర్ధారించారు. రచనలో AI సహాయం తీసుకున్నాం.

AI సహాయంతో చేసిన తెలుగు అనువాదం. మూల ఆధారాలతో పోల్చి, సహజమైన భాష కోసం సంపాదకీయ పరిశీలన చేశాం; మానవ భాషా నిపుణుల సమీక్ష ఇంకా జరగలేదు.

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS: 0–12 ఏళ్ల పిల్లల డెవలప్‌మెంట్‌కు సపోర్ట్ ఇచ్చే సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్; వ్యాధి నిర్ధారణ చేయదు. Plan, ఫలితాలు ఒక్కో బిడ్డకు వేరుగా ఉంటాయి.

మూల పత్రాలు కావాలన్నా, ఈ వివరణ గురించి సందేహం ఉన్నా Sourabh Sashank (Lead PinnacleAI®)ను సంప్రదించండి: care@pinnacleblooms.org లేదా 9100 181 181.

आकलन से रोज़मर्रा के अभ्यास तक

https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/guides/hi/everyday-practice.html

Language: hi-IN

Updated: 2026-09-24

Pinnacle की बताई प्रक्रिया आकलन को बच्चे के लिए बने प्लान, निर्देशित दैनिक गतिविधियों, फीडबैक और दोबारा आकलन से जोड़ती है। माता-पिता, देखभाल करने वाले, शिक्षक और थेरपिस्ट अलग-अलग अनुभव साझा करते हैं। उद्देश्य है एक साझा दिशा, जिसे बच्चे की ज़रूरत के अनुसार बदला जा सके।

तय करें कि बच्चे की दिनचर्या में क्या महत्वपूर्ण है

बच्चे की मौजूदा क्षमताओं, रुचियों और उन परिस्थितियों से शुरुआत करें जहाँ मदद की ज़रूरत है। आकलन को अपनी ज़रूरत बताने, रोज़ के काम में हिस्सा लेने या दूसरों के साथ जुड़ने जैसे लक्ष्यों से जोड़ें। पूछें कि प्लान कौन समझाएगा और अगली समीक्षा का समन्वय कौन करेगा।

MD-5 में माता-पिता, थेरपिस्ट, शिक्षक और देखभाल करने वालों को उपयोगकर्ता बताया गया है। Dossier में Personal Development Kernel का वर्णन है: बच्चे के माप, इतिहास, लक्ष्य और गतिविधियों पर प्रतिक्रिया जुड़े रहते हैं और अगली सिफ़ारिशों में काम आते हैं। सॉफ्टवेयर टीम के निर्णय और समन्वय में मदद करता है।

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

ऐसी गतिविधियाँ माँगें जिन्हें आप समझ सकें

सितंबर handout में दैनिक कार्यक्रम के लिए चुनी गई 7–9 तकनीकों और चार दिन के therapy forecast का वर्णन है। मेथडोलॉजी preprint भी चार दिन पहले कार्यक्रम तैयार करने की बात करता है। ये उन स्रोतों के विवरण हैं; बच्चे के लिए क्या उपयुक्त है, यह उसके व्यक्तिगत प्लान में तय होना चाहिए।

टीम से हर चुनी हुई गतिविधि करके दिखाने, उसका उद्देश्य समझाने और दिनचर्या में उसका समय तय करने को कहें। तकनीकों की सूची तभी उपयोगी होती है जब परिवार समझे कि क्या करना है, क्यों करना है और मदद किससे माँगनी है।

Source: September 2026 handout — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/september-handout.html

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

पेशेवर सहयोग को घर के अभ्यास से जोड़ें

माता-पिता के मार्गदर्शन में अभ्यास, सहमति से चुनी हुई गतिविधि को परिचित परिस्थितियों में करने का हिस्सा है। इसमें पेशेवर सहयोग और निगरानी जुड़े रहते हैं। केवल इसमें भाग लेने से माता-पिता को पेशेवर थेरपिस्ट की योग्यता नहीं मिल जाती।

पूछें कि कौन-से अनुभव साझा करने हैं, बच्चे का कार्यक्रम कौन देख सकता है और सहमति व पहुँच कैसे संभाली जाती है। Dossier में अभिभावक की सहमति और हर व्यक्ति की भूमिका के अनुसार पहुँच देने का वर्णन है।

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

फीडबैक से प्लान को बेहतर बनाएँ

अगर कोई गतिविधि समझने में मुश्किल हो या बच्चा उसमें रुचि न दिखाए, तो टीम को बताएँ। मेथडोलॉजी में तकनीकों की रेटिंग बच्चे के व्यक्तिगत रिकॉर्ड में जाने का वर्णन है। BIS schedule में परिवार, देखभाल करने वालों, थेरपिस्ट और क्लिनिकल टीम के लिए tracking और correction Fusion Module शामिल है।

एक उपयोगी सवाल हो सकता है: ‘शांत कमरे में यह गतिविधि आसान रही; हमें क्या जारी रखना चाहिए और क्या बदलना चाहिए?’ टीम जगह, गतिविधि या सहयोग की समीक्षा कर सकती है। यह बातचीत का उदाहरण है, सुझाया गया उपचार या किसी बच्चे का परिणाम नहीं।

Source: AbilityScore® methodology preprint — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/methodology.html

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

मासिक समीक्षा में अगला कदम तय करें

Company walkthrough में हर महीने दोबारा आकलन का वर्णन है। बच्चे की मौजूदा क्षमताओं को पुराने आकलन से जोड़ें, रोज़ के उदाहरण देखें और पूछें कि अगली प्राथमिकताएँ कैसे तय हुईं। पुष्टि करें कि रिपोर्ट के संस्करण और पैमाने तुलना योग्य हैं।

सात चरण हैं: क्षमताएँ समझना, बच्चे का प्लान, टीम का सहयोग, घर पर अभ्यास, tracking और बदलाव, दोबारा आकलन, और आत्मनिर्भरता व भागीदारी की ओर बढ़ना। Readiness सूचकांक चर्चा को दिशा देते हैं; वे स्कूल प्रवेश या आत्मनिर्भरता की तय तारीख का वादा नहीं करते।

Source: Pinnacle company walkthrough — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/sovereign-walkthrough.html

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

अपनी केयर टीम से पूछने के सवाल

इस बच्चे के प्लान में हर गतिविधि का उद्देश्य क्या है?

क्या कोई इसे करके दिखा सकता है और बता सकता है कि कौन-सा फीडबैक लिखना है?

पिछली समीक्षा से प्लान में क्या बदला और अगली समीक्षा कब होगी?

क्या सभी बच्चे एक ही दैनिक कार्यक्रम करते हैं?

बताई गई प्रक्रिया में बच्चे की क्षमताओं और लक्ष्यों के अनुसार गतिविधियाँ चुनी जाती हैं। सितंबर handout की गिनती उस स्रोत का विवरण है। केयर टीम को बच्चे का व्यक्तिगत प्लान और बदलाव समझाने चाहिए।

मासिक समीक्षा में क्या शामिल होना चाहिए?

बताई प्रक्रिया दोबारा आकलन को पिछली क्षमताओं, रोज़मर्रा के अनुभवों, कठिनाइयों और अगली प्राथमिकताओं से जोड़ती है। रिपोर्ट के संस्करण और पैमाने की पुष्टि करके परिवार पूछ सकता है कि इन बातों से प्लान में क्या बदलाव आएगा।

इन जानकारियों की समीक्षा Pinnacle Clinical Committee ने की है। समीक्षा पूरी होने की पुष्टि 19 सितंबर 2026 को दर्ज की गई। लेखन में AI की सहायता ली गई है।

AI की सहायता से किया गया हिन्दी अनुवाद। स्रोतों से मिलान और सहज भाषा के लिए संपादकीय जाँच की गई है; मानव भाषा विशेषज्ञ की समीक्षा अभी नहीं हुई है।

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS: 0–12 वर्ष के बच्चों के विकास में सहायता के लिए; रोग की पहचान या निदान नहीं करता। हर बच्चे का प्लान और उसके परिणाम अलग हो सकते हैं।

मूल दस्तावेज़ या इस जानकारी के बारे में किसी सवाल के लिए Sourabh Sashank (Lead PinnacleAI®) से संपर्क करें: care@pinnacleblooms.org या 9100 181 181.

What do PinnacleAI®’s MD-5 and BIS records cover?

https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/guides/licences-and-scope.html

Language: en-IN

Updated: 2026-09-24

The reviewed MD-5 records the named device and its non-diagnostic developmental-support intended use for ages 0–12. The BIS licence and schedule describe a quality-management-system scope and named software activities and modules. Reading them together explains distinct parts of the evidence; neither guarantees a child’s outcome.

MD-5: the named device and intended use

The supplied issued manufacturing licence is MFG/MD/2026/000248. Its reviewed record identifies PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 as a Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support device for children aged 0–12. Read the named manufacturer, premises, device version and intended use together.

The annexure describes developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support. Non-diagnostic means this record does not authorise the software to diagnose autism or another condition.

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Parents and caregivers are named users

The intended-use wording names parents, therapists, educators and caregivers. That makes family participation explicit in this device’s documented use. It connects with Pinnacle’s described workflow of shared observations, guided everyday practice and professional review.

The wording does not mean a parent acquires a therapist’s professional qualification, nor does it remove the need for appropriate clinical judgement. The dossier describes clinician-governed assessment and human oversight of recommendations.

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

BIS: the quality-system activities and module scope

BIS licence MD/L-2026029599 and its schedule name design, development, verification and validation, release, deployment, maintenance, technical support and post-market surveillance for the specified software scope.

The schedule includes Ability Score, Prognose®, Everyday Therapy through Therapeutic AI®, tracking and correction, and seven readiness indexes, including Self Sufficiency and Mainstream Inclusion. Its phrase ‘full developmental lifecycle of children’ belongs to this named scope. It does not expand the MD-5 age range or establish a lifelong clinical indication.

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

MD-3: an application, separate from the issued licence

MD-3 is an application for a manufacturing licence for Class A or Class B medical devices. The issued manufacturing licence is MD-5. The evidence library provides separate records so the application step and the licence decision are not mistaken for the same document.

When a provider shows a number or badge, ask which document it identifies and where the original can be read. The useful answer is the actual document, its scope and its status.

Source: MD-3 manufacturing-licence application — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md3.html

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Use each record for the question it can answer

A manufacturing licence, a quality-system record, a facility registration and a research study answer different questions. MD-5 helps establish the named device’s licensed intended use; BIS describes the named quality-system scope. Clinical outcomes need appropriate study evidence.

The Verify library provides source-copy pages, excerpts and review dates. Reviewing a supplied document and confirming its current issuer status are separate checks. Follow each record’s current verification note, and ask for clarification when a scope or status is unclear.

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

Questions to take to your care team

Does the software and version being offered match the named MD-5 record?

How will the care team involve our family within the documented intended use?

Which evidence answers my question: device use, quality system, facility registration or outcomes?

Does the BIS phrase ‘full developmental lifecycle’ change the MD-5 age range?

No. That phrase appears in the BIS scope for named software modules and activities. The reviewed MD-5 intended use remains non-diagnostic developmental support for ages 0–12.

Are MD-3 and MD-5 both issued licences?

No. MD-3 is a manufacturing-licence application. MD-5 is the issued manufacturing licence. The two documents have distinct roles in the regulatory record.

Clinical explanations reviewed by the Pinnacle Clinical Committee. Confirmation recorded: 19 September 2026. Prepared with AI editorial assistance.

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS: non-diagnostic developmental support, ages 0–12. Plans and outcomes are individual.

For source documents or a question about this explanation, contact Sourabh Sashank (Lead PinnacleAI®) at care@pinnacleblooms.org or 9100 181 181.

PinnacleAI® MD-5, BIS పత్రాలు ఏం చెబుతాయి?

https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/guides/te/licences-and-scope.html

Language: te-IN

Updated: 2026-09-24

పరిశీలించిన MD-5లో పేర్కొన్న డివైస్ 0–12 ఏళ్ల పిల్లల డెవలప్‌మెంట్‌కు సపోర్ట్ ఇస్తుంది; వ్యాధి నిర్ధారణ చేయదు. BIS లైసెన్స్, షెడ్యూల్‌లో క్వాలిటీ మేనేజ్‌మెంట్ సిస్టమ్ పరిధి, సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్ పనులు, మాడ్యూల్స్ ఉన్నాయి. ఈ రెండు పత్రాలు వేర్వేరు విషయాలకు ఆధారాలు; బిడ్డకు నిర్దిష్ట ఫలితం వస్తుందని హామీ ఇవ్వవు.

MD-5: ఏ డివైస్, ఏ ఉపయోగం కోసం?

అందించిన తయారీ లైసెన్స్ నంబర్ MFG/MD/2026/000248. పరిశీలించిన రికార్డులో PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0ను 0–12 ఏళ్ల పిల్లల కోసం Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support డివైస్‌గా పేర్కొన్నారు. తయారీదారు, ప్రాంగణం, డివైస్ వెర్షన్, ఉపయోగం—అన్ని వివరాలనూ కలిపి చూడాలి.

అనుబంధంలో developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting, adaptive therapy-plan support ఉన్నాయి. Non-diagnostic అంటే ఆటిజం లేదా మరే పరిస్థితినైనా నిర్ధారించడానికి ఈ పత్రం సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్‌కు అనుమతి ఇవ్వడం లేదు.

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

తల్లిదండ్రులు, కేర్‌గివర్ల పాత్ర పత్రంలోనే ఉంది

Intended-use వాక్యంలో తల్లిదండ్రులు, థెరపిస్టులు, టీచర్లు, కేర్‌గివర్లను పేర్కొన్నారు. అంటే ఈ డివైస్ ఉపయోగంలో కుటుంబం పాల్గొనడం స్పష్టంగా ఉంది. గమనించిన విషయాలు పంచుకోవడం, మార్గదర్శకత్వంతో ఇంట్లో Practice, నిపుణుల రివ్యూ అనే Pinnacle విధానంతో ఇది కలుస్తుంది.

దీనర్థం తల్లిదండ్రులకు థెరపిస్ట్ ప్రొఫెషనల్ అర్హత వచ్చినట్లు కాదు; అవసరమైన క్లినికల్ నిర్ణయాలు అక్కర్లేదని కూడా కాదు. క్లినీషియన్ పర్యవేక్షణలో Assessment, సిఫార్సులపై మానవ పర్యవేక్షణ గురించి Dossier వివరిస్తుంది.

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

BIS: క్వాలిటీ సిస్టమ్ పనులు, మాడ్యూల్స్ పరిధి

BIS లైసెన్స్ MD/L-2026029599, దాని షెడ్యూల్‌లో పేర్కొన్న సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్‌కు design, development, verification and validation, release, deployment, maintenance, technical support, post-market surveillance ఉన్నాయి.

షెడ్యూల్‌లో Ability Score, Prognose®, Therapeutic AI® ద్వారా Everyday Therapy, Tracking–Correction, Self Sufficiency, Mainstream Inclusionతో సహా ఏడు Readiness సూచికలు ఉన్నాయి. ‘Full developmental lifecycle of children’ అనే వాక్యం ఈ పరిధికి సంబంధించినది. అది MD-5లోని వయసు పరిధిని పెంచదు; జీవితాంతం క్లినికల్ ఉపయోగానికి అనుమతిగా తీసుకోకూడదు.

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

MD-3 దరఖాస్తు; MD-5 ఇచ్చిన లైసెన్స్

Class A లేదా Class B మెడికల్ డివైస్‌ల తయారీ లైసెన్స్ కోసం చేసే దరఖాస్తు MD-3. జారీ చేసిన తయారీ లైసెన్స్ MD-5. దరఖాస్తు దశ, ఇచ్చిన లైసెన్స్ ఒకటే అనుకోకుండా ఆధారాల లైబ్రరీలో వేర్వేరు రికార్డులు ఉన్నాయి.

ఎవరైనా నంబర్ లేదా బ్యాడ్జ్ చూపిస్తే, అది ఏ పత్రానికి సంబంధించినది, అసలు పత్రం ఎక్కడ చూడవచ్చో అడగండి. పత్రం, దాని పరిధి, ప్రస్తుత స్థితి స్పష్టంగా తెలుసుకోవడమే ఉపయోగపడుతుంది.

Source: MD-3 manufacturing-licence application — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md3.html

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

మీ ప్రశ్నకు సరిపోయే ఆధారాన్ని చూడండి

తయారీ లైసెన్స్, క్వాలిటీ సిస్టమ్ పత్రం, సెంటర్ రిజిస్ట్రేషన్, పరిశోధన—ఒక్కొక్కటి ఒక్కో ప్రశ్నకు జవాబు ఇస్తుంది. పేర్కొన్న డివైస్‌ను ఏ ఉపయోగం కోసం అనుమతించారో MD-5 చెబుతుంది. పేర్కొన్న క్వాలిటీ సిస్టమ్ పరిధిని BIS వివరిస్తుంది. క్లినికల్ ఫలితాలకు తగిన పరిశోధన ఆధారాలు కావాలి.

Verify లైబ్రరీలో మూల పత్రాల కాపీలు, సంబంధిత వాక్యాలు, పరిశీలించిన తేదీలు ఉన్నాయి. అందించిన పత్రాన్ని చూడటం, అది జారీ చేసిన సంస్థలో ప్రస్తుత స్థితిని తనిఖీ చేయడం వేర్వేరు పనులు. ప్రతి రికార్డులోని ప్రస్తుత verification note చూడండి; పరిధి లేదా స్థితి స్పష్టంగా లేకపోతే అడగండి.

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

మీ కేర్ టీమ్‌ను అడగాల్సిన ప్రశ్నలు

ఇస్తున్న సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్, దాని వెర్షన్ MD-5 రికార్డుతో సరిపోతున్నాయా?

పత్రంలో పేర్కొన్న ఉపయోగం ప్రకారం మా కుటుంబాన్ని టీమ్ ఎలా భాగం చేస్తుంది?

నా ప్రశ్న డివైస్ ఉపయోగమా, క్వాలిటీ సిస్టమా, సెంటర్ రిజిస్ట్రేషనా, ఫలితాల గురించా—దానికి ఏ ఆధారం సరిపోతుంది?

BISలో ‘full developmental lifecycle’ అంటే MD-5 వయసు పరిధి మారుతుందా?

మారదు. ఆ వాక్యం BISలో పేర్కొన్న సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్ మాడ్యూల్స్, పనుల పరిధిలో ఉంది. పరిశీలించిన MD-5 ఉపయోగం 0–12 ఏళ్ల పిల్లలకు, వ్యాధి నిర్ధారణ చేయని డెవలప్‌మెంట్ సపోర్ట్‌గానే ఉంటుంది.

MD-3, MD-5 రెండూ ఇచ్చిన లైసెన్స్‌లేనా?

కాదు. MD-3 తయారీ లైసెన్స్ కోసం దరఖాస్తు. MD-5 జారీ చేసిన తయారీ లైసెన్స్. నియంత్రణ రికార్డులో వాటి పాత్రలు వేర్వేరు.

ఈ వివరణలను Pinnacle Clinical Committee సమీక్షించింది. సమీక్ష పూర్తయినట్లు 19 సెప్టెంబర్ 2026న నిర్ధారించారు. రచనలో AI సహాయం తీసుకున్నాం.

AI సహాయంతో చేసిన తెలుగు అనువాదం. మూల ఆధారాలతో పోల్చి, సహజమైన భాష కోసం సంపాదకీయ పరిశీలన చేశాం; మానవ భాషా నిపుణుల సమీక్ష ఇంకా జరగలేదు.

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS: 0–12 ఏళ్ల పిల్లల డెవలప్‌మెంట్‌కు సపోర్ట్ ఇచ్చే సాఫ్ట్‌వేర్; వ్యాధి నిర్ధారణ చేయదు. Plan, ఫలితాలు ఒక్కో బిడ్డకు వేరుగా ఉంటాయి.

మూల పత్రాలు కావాలన్నా, ఈ వివరణ గురించి సందేహం ఉన్నా Sourabh Sashank (Lead PinnacleAI®)ను సంప్రదించండి: care@pinnacleblooms.org లేదా 9100 181 181.

PinnacleAI® के MD-5 और BIS रिकॉर्ड क्या बताते हैं?

https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/guides/hi/licences-and-scope.html

Language: hi-IN

Updated: 2026-09-24

जाँचा गया MD-5 नामित डिवाइस को 0–12 वर्ष के बच्चों के विकास में सहायता के लिए दर्ज करता है; यह रोग का निदान नहीं करता। BIS लाइसेंस और schedule गुणवत्ता-प्रबंधन प्रणाली का दायरा तथा सॉफ्टवेयर के काम और मॉड्यूल बताते हैं। दोनों अलग तरह के प्रमाण हैं; बच्चे के परिणाम की गारंटी नहीं।

MD-5: नामित डिवाइस और उसका उपयोग

दिया गया विनिर्माण लाइसेंस MFG/MD/2026/000248 है। जाँचे गए रिकॉर्ड में PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 को 0–12 वर्ष के बच्चों के लिए Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support डिवाइस बताया गया है। निर्माता, परिसर, डिवाइस के संस्करण और उसके उपयोग को साथ पढ़ें।

अनुलग्नक में विकास संबंधी क्षमताओं का मापन, readiness tracking, progress forecasting और बदलती ज़रूरत के अनुसार therapy-plan support का वर्णन है। Non-diagnostic का अर्थ है कि यह रिकॉर्ड सॉफ्टवेयर को ऑटिज़्म या किसी अन्य स्थिति का निदान करने की अनुमति नहीं देता।

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

माता-पिता और देखभाल करने वाले नामित उपयोगकर्ता हैं

Intended-use के शब्दों में माता-पिता, थेरपिस्ट, शिक्षक और देखभाल करने वाले शामिल हैं। यानी परिवार की भागीदारी इस डिवाइस के दर्ज उपयोग में स्पष्ट है। यह साझा अनुभवों, निर्देशित रोज़मर्रा के अभ्यास और पेशेवर समीक्षा वाली Pinnacle की बताई प्रक्रिया से जुड़ती है।

इसका अर्थ यह नहीं कि माता-पिता को थेरपिस्ट की पेशेवर योग्यता मिल जाती है या उचित क्लिनिकल निर्णय की ज़रूरत खत्म होती है। Dossier में क्लिनिशियन की निगरानी वाले आकलन और सिफ़ारिशों पर मानव निगरानी का वर्णन है।

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Source: Pinnacle Evidence Dossier — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/dossier.html

BIS: गुणवत्ता प्रणाली के काम और मॉड्यूल

BIS लाइसेंस MD/L-2026029599 और उसके schedule में निर्दिष्ट सॉफ्टवेयर के लिए design, development, verification and validation, release, deployment, maintenance, technical support और post-market surveillance शामिल हैं।

Schedule में Ability Score, Prognose®, Therapeutic AI® के माध्यम से Everyday Therapy, tracking और correction, तथा Self Sufficiency और Mainstream Inclusion सहित सात readiness सूचकांक हैं। ‘Full developmental lifecycle of children’ इसी दायरे का वाक्य है। यह MD-5 की उम्र-सीमा नहीं बढ़ाता और आजीवन क्लिनिकल उपयोग की अनुमति स्थापित नहीं करता।

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

MD-3 आवेदन है; MD-5 जारी लाइसेंस है

MD-3, Class A या Class B मेडिकल डिवाइस के विनिर्माण लाइसेंस के लिए आवेदन है। जारी विनिर्माण लाइसेंस MD-5 है। प्रमाण लाइब्रेरी में दोनों रिकॉर्ड अलग हैं, ताकि आवेदन के चरण और जारी लाइसेंस को एक ही दस्तावेज़ न समझा जाए।

कोई प्रदाता नंबर या बैज दिखाए तो पूछें कि वह किस दस्तावेज़ का है और मूल दस्तावेज़ कहाँ पढ़ सकते हैं। दस्तावेज़, उसका दायरा और उसकी स्थिति स्पष्ट होना उपयोगी है।

Source: MD-3 manufacturing-licence application — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md3.html

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

हर सवाल के लिए सही प्रमाण देखें

विनिर्माण लाइसेंस, गुणवत्ता प्रणाली का रिकॉर्ड, केंद्र का पंजीकरण और शोध अध्ययन अलग सवालों का जवाब देते हैं। MD-5 नामित डिवाइस के लाइसेंस में दर्ज उपयोग को बताता है; BIS नामित गुणवत्ता प्रणाली का दायरा समझाता है। क्लिनिकल परिणामों के लिए उपयुक्त अध्ययन प्रमाण चाहिए।

Verify लाइब्रेरी में स्रोत की प्रतियाँ, संबंधित अंश और जाँच की तारीखें हैं। दिए गए दस्तावेज़ को देखना और जारी करने वाली संस्था से उसकी वर्तमान स्थिति की पुष्टि करना अलग जाँच हैं। हर रिकॉर्ड का मौजूदा verification note पढ़ें और दायरा या स्थिति अस्पष्ट हो तो सवाल पूछें।

Source: MD-5: MFG/MD/2026/000248 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/md5.html

Source: BIS: MD/L-2026029599 — https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/bis.html

अपनी केयर टीम से पूछने के सवाल

क्या दिया जा रहा सॉफ्टवेयर और उसका संस्करण नामित MD-5 रिकॉर्ड से मेल खाते हैं?

दर्ज उपयोग के अनुसार केयर टीम हमारे परिवार को कैसे शामिल करेगी?

मेरा सवाल डिवाइस के उपयोग, गुणवत्ता प्रणाली, केंद्र के पंजीकरण या परिणामों में से किसके बारे में है?

क्या BIS का ‘full developmental lifecycle’ वाक्य MD-5 की उम्र-सीमा बदलता है?

नहीं। यह वाक्य BIS में नामित सॉफ्टवेयर मॉड्यूल और गतिविधियों के दायरे में है। जाँचे गए MD-5 का उपयोग 0–12 वर्ष के बच्चों के लिए non-diagnostic developmental support ही है।

क्या MD-3 और MD-5 दोनों जारी लाइसेंस हैं?

नहीं। MD-3 विनिर्माण लाइसेंस का आवेदन है। MD-5 जारी विनिर्माण लाइसेंस है। नियामक रिकॉर्ड में दोनों की भूमिका अलग है।

इन जानकारियों की समीक्षा Pinnacle Clinical Committee ने की है। समीक्षा पूरी होने की पुष्टि 19 सितंबर 2026 को दर्ज की गई। लेखन में AI की सहायता ली गई है।

AI की सहायता से किया गया हिन्दी अनुवाद। स्रोतों से मिलान और सहज भाषा के लिए संपादकीय जाँच की गई है; मानव भाषा विशेषज्ञ की समीक्षा अभी नहीं हुई है।

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS: 0–12 वर्ष के बच्चों के विकास में सहायता के लिए; रोग की पहचान या निदान नहीं करता। हर बच्चे का प्लान और उसके परिणाम अलग हो सकते हैं।

मूल दस्तावेज़ या इस जानकारी के बारे में किसी सवाल के लिए Sourabh Sashank (Lead PinnacleAI®) से संपर्क करें: care@pinnacleblooms.org या 9100 181 181.

## Brand, company and history
Pinnacle Blooms Network is the brand; Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited is the legal entity named in the identity and licensing records. The name-change certificate records the earlier company name, Bharath Diagnostics Labs Private Limited, and the change on 18 May 2017. The institutional reports use incorporation in 2016 as the start of corporate operating history. These records do not establish a separate founding date for the Pinnacle brand or a 16-year corporate history. A reference entry should identify the company incorporation year and the brand founding date as separate facts.

## Developmental approach and licensed scope
Pinnacle describes a seven-stage pathway: identify capabilities and measure ability; forecast readiness and create a child-specific plan; provide integrated intervention; support parent-guided everyday practice; track progress and correct the plan; reassess and repeat until readiness; and support growing independence and participation. This is the company’s service and educational explanation. The MD-5 separately specifies the named software version, manufacturer, premises and intended use: developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support for children aged 0–12. It is non-diagnostic. Free Sale Certificate FSC/MD/2026/000741 records Indian domestic marketability and export eligibility for that named device, subject to the importing country’s law; it is not foreign approval. The BIS schedule describes management-system activities and named developmental modules. These records do not establish a guaranteed child outcome or comparative superiority.

## Dated institutional counts and independent reports
At 17 July 2026, the SRS 4400 report records 31,052,382 cumulative services, 792,614 beneficiary/family registrations, 2.7 billion-plus structured developmental records and 49 centres meeting its operational definition. Services include assessments, screenings and parent training; registrations are counted under the report’s beneficiary/family criteria; structured records include platform events. These units describe different aspects of operations and should not be added together or treated as clinical successes. NPSY & Co.’s separate SAE 3000 report provides limited assurance over stated assertions and thresholds. SRS 4400 reports agreed procedures and factual findings without an assurance conclusion.
